name: Ivándárda (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of green and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Ivándárda (a shield of green and yellow with a ploughshare, ears of grain, a cross and a heart) above a scroll inscribed IVÁNDÁRDA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
